title: Welcome to AIDAMS
text: Parcoursup is over and you survived it. Straight out of high school, you're in AIDAMS, the ESSEC × CentraleSupélec bachelor in AI, data and management: Year 1 on the windy plateau de Saclay, Year 2 in Cergy. First real decision, {name}: where do you sleep this year?

variants.text: The international admissions are behind you, your diploma is stamped and your visa almost is. You're in AIDAMS, the ESSEC × CentraleSupélec bachelor in AI, data and management: Year 1 on the windy plateau de Saclay, Year 2 in Cergy. First real decision, {name}: where do you sleep this year?

ai.tone: warm, excited, slightly overwhelmed first week
hints: Weave in the player's origin, family budget and trait naturally, in one clause.
The plateau de Saclay wind and the RER B are running jokes for the whole game.
The player arrives straight from high school (French bac via Parcoursup, or an international diploma): never mention prépa, a concours or any earlier degree.
Only Paris-region families can host the player: if the parents live far away (abroad, a regional city, a small town), say lightly that staying at home is impossible.

effects.text: Your room is nine square metres. Your next-door neighbour Lou already knows everyone. The wind on the plateau is free.
Your flatmate Lou cooks pasta at midnight. You learn the RER B timetable by heart. The RER B does not.
Home-cooked dinners, your childhood bedroom and a curfew you thought you'd outgrown.

choices.label: Your own studio in Paris
choices.hint: Privacy, a view, a big bill

effects.text: A studio with a balcony and a view on the rooftops. Your classmates call it 'the embassy'.
